day3_start.name: Me
day3_start.text: *I wake up to the sound of my alarm. It's already been three days since I transferred... I'm starting to get used to waking up in the morning.*

day3_nurse_home_morning.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning.text: *I open my eyes... Where am I? An unfamiliar ceiling.*

day3_nurse_home_morning_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning_2.text: *Memories of last night flash through my mind. Her scent, her soft touch, and...*

day3_nurse_home_morning_3.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_3.text: "Oh my, you're awake? Hehe, did you sleep well last night?"

day3_nurse_home_morning_4.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning_4.text: *She hands me a cup of coffee with a knowing smile. My face feels hot.*

day3_nurse_home_morning_thanks.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_thanks.text: "Hehe, don't be so stiff. Not after what we shared."

day3_nurse_home_morning_bold.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_bold.text: "Oh my... Bold thing to say in the morning. Hehe, teacher enjoyed it too."

day3_nurse_home_morning_shy.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_shy.text: "Hehe, so cute. Your shy face is adorable too."

day3_nurse_home_morning_leave.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_leave.text: "Now, hurry up and get ready. You need to go to school, right? When we see each other at school... pretend nothing happened, okay?"

day3_nurse_home_morning_leave_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning_leave_2.text: *My heart races at her wink. I quickly gather my things and leave her place.*

day3_nurse_home_school_arrival.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_school_arrival.text: *I arrived at school. The morning air feels especially refreshing today.*

day3_nurse_home_suspicion.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_suspicion.text: "{name}! Good morning... Huh? Where did you come from today? It seems like you came from a different direction than usual..."

day3_nurse_home_stutter.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_stutter.text: "...Why can't you answer? Are you hiding something?"

day3_nurse_home_yuna_appears_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_yuna_appears_2.text: *Yuna stares at my face. Her eyes are... piercing.*

day3_nurse_home_tension_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_tension_2.text: *The atmosphere became tense. I need to get out of this situation somehow.*
choices: "I'll be late for class, gotta go!"
"It's a misunderstanding, I was at my parents' friend's place..."

day3_nurse_home_escape.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_escape.text: *I hurry to the classroom. The gazes from behind feel burning hot...*

day3_nurse_home_excuse.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_excuse.text: "...Your parents' friend? Then why did you act like you were hiding something?"

day3_nurse_home_excuse_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_excuse_2.text: *Seoyeon looks upset. Let's just head to the classroom for now.*

day3_start_2.name: Me
day3_start_2.text: *Looking outside, the weather is really nice today. It's already Friday... What should I do this weekend?*

day3_start_3.name: Me
day3_start_3.text: *I check my smartphone and see there are unread messages. Who could it be?*

day3_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_msg_seoyeon.text: *Message sent at 6 AM* 'Good morning! {name}, fighting for today too! Oh, and would you like to walk to school together? I'll wait for you in front of your house!'

day3_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day3_msg_yuna.text: *Message sent at 3 AM* '...{name}. I'll wait for you at the back gate this morning. Let's go together.'

day3_msg_dain.name: Dain
day3_msg_dain.text: *Message sent at 7 AM* 'Yay! {name}! Let's go to school together! Where do you live? I'll come find you! ><'

day3_msg_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_msg_nurse.text: *Message sent last night at 11 PM* 'Hehe, {name}. How about walking to school together this morning? Just the two of us... 😉'

day3_msg_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_msg_teacher.text: *Message sent last night at 10 PM* '{name}, are you going to school early tomorrow morning? I'm going early too, would you like to walk together?'

day3_reject_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_reject_msg_seoyeon.text: *Reply* 'Oh... I see. It's okay! See you at school then!'

day3_reject_msg_yuna.name: Yuna
day3_reject_msg_yuna.text: *Reply* '...Alright. Sometimes it's more comfortable to go alone.'

day3_reject_msg_dain.name: Dain
day3_reject_msg_dain.text: *Reply* 'Aw, that's too bad! But see you at school!'

day3_reject_msg_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_reject_msg_nurse.text: *Reply* 'Oh my, really? That's a shame. See you at school then.'

day3_msg_seoyeon_after_reject.name: Seoyeon
day3_msg_seoyeon_after_reject.text: *Message sent at 6 AM* 'Good morning! {name}, fighting for today too! Oh, and would you like to walk to school together? I'll wait for you in front of your house!'
choices: Go with Seoyeon *I rejected her earlier...*

day3_msg_yuna_after_reject.name: Yuna
day3_msg_yuna_after_reject.text: *Message sent at 3 AM* '...{name}. I'll wait for you at the back gate this morning. Let's go together.'
choices: Go with Yuna *I rejected her earlier...*

day3_msg_dain_after_reject.name: Dain
day3_msg_dain_after_reject.text: *Message sent at 7 AM* 'Yay! {name}! Let's go to school together! Where do you live? I'll come find you! ><'
choices: Go with Dain *I rejected her earlier...*

day3_msg_nurse_after_reject.name: School Nurse
day3_msg_nurse_after_reject.text: *Message sent last night at 11 PM* 'Hehe, {name}. How about walking to school together this morning? Just the two of us... 😉'
choices: Go with Nurse *I rejected her earlier...*

day3_msg_teacher_after_reject.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_msg_teacher_after_reject.text: *Message sent last night at 10 PM* '{name}, are you going to school early tomorrow morning? I'm going early too, would you like to walk together?'
choices: Go with Teacher *I rejected her earlier...*

day3_change_mind.name: Me
day3_change_mind.text: *I sent another message. 'Sorry, I just checked other messages. I actually want to go together!'*

day3_change_mind_teachers.name: Me
day3_change_mind_teachers.text: *I sent another message. 'Sorry, I actually want to go together!'*

day3_change_mind_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_change_mind_seoyeon.text: *Immediate reply* 'Really?! Great! Then hurry up and come out! I'll wait!'

day3_change_mind_dain.name: Dain
day3_change_mind_dain.text: *Immediate reply* 'Okay! I'm leaving now! Wait for me!'

day3_change_mind_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_change_mind_nurse.text: *Reply* 'Hehe, changed your mind? Good, come out quickly.'

day3_walk_with_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_walk_with_seoyeon.text: *I headed to the front of Seoyeon's house.*

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream.text: *Walking side by side* "Hey, {name}. Do you know what I dreamed about last night?"

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_ask.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_ask.text: *Seoyeon's face turns red* "I-it's a secret! It was nothing! Why are you asking?!"

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_me.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_me.text: *Seoyeon freezes* "W-what?! Why would you think that! ...Okay, maybe, but that's not the point!"

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_bad.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_bad.text: *Seoyeon sighs* "Ugh, you totally killed the mood. It was a good dream, you know!"

day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk.name: Me
day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk.text: *We wait for the light at the crosswalk. Standing still, Seoyeon's hand is tantalizingly close to mine.*

day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk_2.name: Me
day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk_2.text: *Seoyeon lightly brushes my hand with her pinky finger. Our eyes meet, and we both look away at the same time.*

day3_walk_seoyeon_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *We chat about various things on the way to school.*
day3_walk_seoyeon_freetalk.context: Walking to school with Seoyeon side by side. Our hands touched at the crosswalk, so there's a slightly self-conscious atmosphere. It's Friday morning, so weekend plans might come up.

day3_seoyeon_weekend_talk.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_talk.text: *As the school gate comes into view, Seoyeon stutters as if trying to say something difficult* "Um... {name}. Are you free this weekend? There's a café I've been wanting to visit..."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_ask.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_ask.text: "I saw it on social media, and it has a really pretty vibe. It's awkward going alone though... Let's meet at the park fountain at 2 PM on Saturday!"

day3_seoyeon_weekend_tease.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_tease.text: *Seoyeon's face turns bright red* "W-what?! It's just friends hanging out! ...But I didn't invite anyone else. Saturday at 2 PM, at the park fountain."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_direct.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_direct.text: *Seoyeon beams* "Really?! Saturday at 2 PM, at the park fountain! You better not be late!"

day3_seoyeon_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_seoyeon_weekend_choice.text: *Seoyeon looks at me with eyes full of anticipation.*

day3_seoyeon_weekend_yes.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_yes.text: *Seoyeon nearly shouts but quickly covers her mouth* "...Ahem! O-okay. See you Saturday then. You can look forward to it!"

day3_seoyeon_weekend_later.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_later.text: *Seoyeon's expression dims slightly* "...Okay, I see. Let me know later then."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_no.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_no.text: *Seoyeon forces a smile* "...Oh, is that so? It's fine! We can go some other time!"

day3_walk_with_yuna.name: Me
day3_walk_with_yuna.text: *I headed toward the alley on the way to school. Yuna is standing under the shade of a tree.*

day3_walk_yuna_greet.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_greet.text: "...You came. (Walking quietly) The weather is nice today. But... things that look peaceful are often the most dangerous."

day3_walk_yuna_leaf.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_leaf.text: *A leaf blown by the wind lands on my head. Yuna quietly reaches out and picks it off.*

day3_walk_yuna_leaf_3.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_leaf_3.text: *My heart skips at Yuna's deadpan remark. Before I can respond, Yuna suddenly stops walking.*

day3_walk_yuna_necktie_2.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_necktie_2.text: *Yuna starts fixing my necktie. Her face is barely 10 centimeters away from mine.*

day3_walk_yuna_necktie_still.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_necktie_still.text: "...Dummy. How can you walk around with it this loose."

day3_walk_yuna_necktie_cold.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_necktie_cold.text: *Yuna's hands pause. After a moment of silence* "...Want me to warm them up?"

day3_walk_yuna_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_freetalk.text: *I walk alongside Yuna toward school. A quiet but comfortable silence fills the air.*
day3_walk_yuna_freetalk.context: Walking to school with Yuna in the morning. She just fixed my necktie, creating an oddly intimate atmosphere. It's quiet but the distance between us feels close.

day3_walk_yuna_talk.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_talk.text: *Walking down the quiet path, Yuna suddenly speaks* "{name}, this weekend... there's a place I want to show only you."

day3_yuna_weekend_ask.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_ask.text: "...A place where you can see the real face of this school. Saturday evening at 8 PM, at the school's back gate. Don't be late. There are things that can only be seen in the darkness."

day3_yuna_weekend_curious.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_curious.text: *Yuna smiles coldly* "It's closer to the truth than a secret. Saturday evening at 8 PM. Everything changes after the sun sets. You'll come, right?"

day3_yuna_weekend_direct.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_direct.text: *Yuna looks at me in surprise, then smiles* "...That's so like you. Saturday evening at 8 PM, school back gate. There are things that can only be seen when darkness falls. You must come."

day3_yuna_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_yuna_weekend_choice.text: *Yuna's serious gaze pierces through me. 8 PM in the evening... Something feels ominous.*
choices: Let me think about it and reply

day3_yuna_weekend_yes.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_yes.text: *Yuna briefly holds my hand then lets go* "...Thank you. You won't regret it. Saturday night, be ready to face the truth."

day3_yuna_weekend_later.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_later.text: *Yuna looks disappointed and turns her head away* "...I see. But there's only one chance. Think carefully. There's a door that only opens at night."

day3_walk_with_dain.name: Me
day3_walk_with_dain.text: *On the way to the meeting spot. From a distance, Dain is waving her hand widely and running toward me.*

day3_walk_dain_bump_2.name: Me
day3_walk_dain_bump_2.text: *Dain charges at me full speed with no brakes. There's no time to dodge— CRASH!*

day3_walk_dain_bump_4.name: Me
day3_walk_dain_bump_4.text: *Dain fell on top of me. Our faces are barely 10 centimeters apart... I can feel her breath.*

day3_walk_dain_help.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_help.text: *As I take her hand and help her up, Dain's face turns beet red* "Th-thanks... My heart almost exploded! I mean from the crash! Not for any other reason!"

day3_walk_dain_bold.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_bold.text: "Huh?! Y-you idiot! Get up now! People are watching!"

day3_walk_dain_freeze.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_freeze.text: "Hey, what's wrong?! Who's blushing here?! ...Am I blushing too? Ugh, whatever!"

day3_walk_dain_greet_shy.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_greet_shy.text: *Jumping up and dusting herself off* "...Dummy. What are you doing first thing in the morning."

day3_walk_dain_greet.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_greet.text: *Composing herself* "A-anyway! Let's walk to school together! The weather is perfect for exercise today!"

day3_walk_dain_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_dain_freetalk.text: *I walk alongside Dain toward school. Perhaps because of the earlier collision, she's keeping a bit more distance than usual.*
day3_walk_dain_freetalk.context: Walking to school with Dain. There was a bumping incident earlier so Dain is a bit shy. She's energetic but blushes occasionally.

day3_walk_dain_talk.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_talk.text: *Walking excitedly* "Oh! By the way {name}! Tomorrow at 9 AM, our team has a practice match at the gym. Come cheer for me!"
choices: Sounds fun! Of course I'll go!

day3_dain_weekend_ask.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_ask.text: *Dain jumps excitedly* "Really?! Awesome! Then after practice, let's eat together! Let's go get tteokbokki!"

day3_dain_weekend_early.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_early.text: *Dain smiles* "Right? It's hard for me to wake up early too, but it would really give me energy if you came!"

day3_dain_weekend_hesitate.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_hesitate.text: *Dain puts her arm around my shoulder* "It's okay! Just come and cheer! I'll show you my awesome spike!"

day3_dain_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_dain_weekend_choice.text: *Dain looks at me with hopeful eyes.*
choices: Okay! See you Saturday at 9 at the gym
Let me think about it and contact you
Good luck, I have other plans this weekend...

day3_dain_weekend_yes.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_yes.text: *Dain grabs my hand and shakes it* "Wow! You're the best {name}! Then see you on Saturday! Don't be late!"

day3_dain_weekend_later.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_later.text: *Dain looks a bit down* "Aw... But you have to come, okay? Promise?"

day3_dain_weekend_no.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_no.text: *Dain makes a disappointed face* "Oh... I see. But if you have time later, make sure to visit!"

day3_walk_with_nurse.name: Me
day3_walk_with_nurse.text: *I headed to the meeting spot with the teacher. The school nurse is waiting.*

day3_walk_nurse_greet.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_greet.text: "Oh my, {name}. You came? Hehe, our transfer student is so nice. Come on, let's walk together."

day3_walk_nurse_arm.name: Me
day3_walk_nurse_arm.text: *The teacher subtly places her hand on my arm as we walk side by side. What would people think if they saw us...*

day3_walk_nurse_enjoy.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_enjoy.text: *The teacher smiles with satisfaction* "Hehe, this is nice. Walking together like this."

day3_walk_nurse_worry.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_worry.text: *The teacher sighs softly and removes her hand* "You're right... We can't let anyone find out about us."

day3_walk_nurse_conflict.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_conflict.text: *Looking lost in thought, she says quietly* "...{name}, I know a teacher shouldn't be doing this with a student... but my heart won't listen."

day3_walk_nurse_conflict_2.name: Me
day3_walk_nurse_conflict_2.text: *There's an unusual seriousness in her voice. Is she struggling with this too?*

day3_walk_nurse_confess.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_confess.text: *Her eyes go wide* "...You're really dangerous, you know? Making a teacher's heart waver like this."

day3_walk_nurse_hand.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_hand.text: *She looks down at our hands in surprise... then holds on tight* "...Just five seconds. Let's stay like this for just five seconds."

day3_walk_nurse_boundary.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_boundary.text: *Her expression freezes for a moment before she forces a smile* "...Right. A teacher is a teacher, after all."

day3_walk_nurse_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_nurse_freetalk.text: *I walk toward school with the nurse. A strange mix of tension and excitement fills the air.*
day3_walk_nurse_freetalk.context: Walking to school with the school nurse. She confessed that she shouldn't feel this way about a student. The tension of a forbidden love hangs in the air.

day3_walk_nurse_talk.name: School Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_talk.text: *Walking to school, the teacher subtly places her hand on my arm* "Say, {name}. Do you have time this weekend?"
choices: Yes, why? Is something going on?
Well... what are your plans for the weekend?
I don't have any plans yet?

day3_nurse_weekend_ask.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_ask.text: *The teacher smiles meaningfully* "Hehe, actually... I reserved a nice restaurant for Sunday evening. It'd be a shame to go alone... Want to come with me? How about Sunday evening at 7?"

day3_nurse_weekend_curious.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_curious.text: *The teacher winks playfully* "Hmm... I have a nice restaurant reserved and I wanted to go together. If you're okay with it... Sunday evening at 7?"

day3_nurse_weekend_none.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_none.text: *The teacher smiles with satisfaction* "Really? Then let's have dinner together on Sunday evening! How about meeting at 7? I'll send you the address."

day3_nurse_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_nurse_weekend_choice.text: *The teacher gazes at me with captivating eyes. My heart is racing...*
choices: Sure! I'll definitely be there on Sunday
Let me think about it and reply later
Sorry, I have other plans this weekend...

day3_nurse_weekend_yes.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_yes.text: *The teacher gently squeezes my hand then lets go* "Hehe, really? Then Sunday evening at 7, I'll be looking forward to it. Dress up nice, okay?"

day3_nurse_weekend_later.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_later.text: *The teacher makes a slightly disappointed face* "Oh... really? Then come visit the nurse's office at lunchtime. Let's talk again."

day3_nurse_weekend_no.name: School Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_no.text: *The teacher's smile stiffens slightly* "...I see. That's okay. Maybe next time."

day3_walk_with_teacher.name: Me
day3_walk_with_teacher.text: *I headed to the meeting spot. The homeroom teacher is waving from the car.*

day3_walk_teacher_greet.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_greet.text: "{name}! Good morning! It's nice to commute together by car. Now, put on your seatbelt."

day3_walk_teacher_car.name: Me
day3_walk_teacher_car.text: *I got into the teacher's car. A subtle perfume scent and soft music fills the air. It feels awkward yet exciting.*

day3_walk_teacher_hair.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_hair.text: *While stopped at a red light, the teacher suddenly reaches out to fix my hair* "...Hold on. This part was messy."

day3_walk_teacher_hair_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_hair_2.text: *She pauses, whispering* "...I shouldn't be doing this to a student."

day3_walk_teacher_conflict.name: Me
day3_walk_teacher_conflict.text: *Her touch is warm. The air inside the car shifts to something strange.*

day3_walk_teacher_warm.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_warm.text: *The teacher pulls her hand back, flustered* "Oh my, this kid... Surprising a teacher like that."

day3_walk_teacher_hold.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_hold.text: *She looks at our hands in surprise... but doesn't pull away* "...When the light changes, I'm letting go. Promise."

day3_walk_teacher_calm.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_calm.text: *The teacher smiles wistfully* "...Thank you. Was teacher being a bit strange?"

day3_walk_teacher_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_teacher_freetalk.text: *Riding in the homeroom teacher's car on the way to school.*
day3_walk_teacher_freetalk.context: In the homeroom teacher's car on the way to school. She fixed my hair and said 'I shouldn't be doing this to a student.' The tension of a forbidden love hangs in the air.

day3_walk_teacher_talk.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_talk.text: *While driving, the teacher carefully brings up a topic* "Say, {name}. Do you have time this weekend?"
choices: Yes, why? Is something going on?
Well... what are your plans for the weekend?
I don't have any plans yet?

day3_teacher_weekend_ask.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_ask.text: *The teacher glances at me and smiles* "Actually... I got two tickets for a museum exhibition. It'd be a shame to go alone... Want to come with me? How about Sunday afternoon at 2?"

day3_teacher_weekend_curious.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_curious.text: "Hmm... I have museum exhibition tickets and I wanted to go together. If you're okay with it... Sunday afternoon at 2?"

day3_teacher_weekend_none.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_none.text: *The teacher's face lights up* "Really? Then let's go see the museum exhibition on Sunday afternoon! How about meeting at the museum at 2?"

day3_teacher_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_teacher_weekend_choice.text: *The teacher glances at me with hopeful eyes. The air in the car feels unusually warm...*
choices: Sure! I'll definitely be there on Sunday
Let me think about it and reply later

day3_teacher_weekend_yes.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_yes.text: *The teacher smiles brightly* "Really? Then Sunday at 2 PM, it's a date. It'll be fun!"

day3_teacher_weekend_later.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_later.text: *The teacher makes a slightly disappointed face* "Oh... really? Then let's talk again at lunchtime."

day3_teacher_weekend_no.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_no.text: *The teacher's expression stiffens for a moment* "...That's disappointing. I had high expectations for you."

day3_prepare_school.name: Me
day3_prepare_school.text: *I hurried to get ready for school.*

day3_prepare_school_ads.name: Me
day3_prepare_school_ads.text: *'Limited time sale! Order now...', 'Congratulations on winning the event...'* ...They're all spam messages. Looks like I'm going to school alone today.

day3_walk_alone.name: Me
day3_walk_alone.text: *I headed to school alone. The morning air is refreshing.*

day3_arrive_school.name: Me
day3_arrive_school.text: *Before I knew it, I arrived at the school gate. Another lively day begins.*

day3_classroom.name: Me
day3_classroom.text: *As I enter the classroom, the kids are buzzing. I sit down at my desk and notice... something is on it.*

day3_classroom_note_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_classroom_note_seoyeon.text: *There's a small note. 'Let's eat lunch together ♡ - Seoyeon' ... We were literally just together, and she left a note in advance?*

day3_classroom_note_yuna.name: Me
day3_classroom_note_yuna.text: *There's an origami crow. I unfold its wings to find writing inside. '...Tomorrow night' — Looks like Yuna left it.*

day3_classroom_note_dain.name: Me
day3_classroom_note_dain.text: *There's an energy bar and a sticky note. 'If you don't exercise, at least eat this! - Dain' ... She must have left it earlier.*

day3_classroom_empty.name: Me
day3_classroom_empty.text: *Nothing on my desk. Just an ordinary Friday morning.*

day3_classroom_class_start.name: Me
day3_classroom_class_start.text: *Class begins. The homeroom teacher starts writing problems on the board.*

day3_classroom_teacher_event.name: Me
day3_classroom_teacher_event.text: *When the teacher raises her arm to write on the board, a subtle whiff of perfume drifts over. No one else seems to notice... only me.*

day3_classroom_teacher_wink.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_classroom_teacher_wink.text: *While asking a question, her eyes meet mine... she gives a subtle wink* "...{name}, your answer?"

day3_classroom_teacher_glance.name: Me
day3_classroom_teacher_glance.text: *The teacher glances my way and smiles faintly. Is she thinking about our Sunday plans?*

day3_classroom_nurse_visit.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_visit.text: *Mid-class, the classroom door opens and the school nurse walks in.*

day3_classroom_nurse_visit_2.name: School Nurse
day3_classroom_nurse_visit_2.text: "Sorry to interrupt, teacher. I'm here to hand out health surveys."

day3_classroom_nurse_visit_3.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_visit_3.text: *The nurse pauses in front of me while handing out surveys. Her fingers lightly brush against my hand.*

day3_classroom_nurse_secret.name: School Nurse
day3_classroom_nurse_secret.text: *Without anyone noticing, she slips a small note between the survey pages. 'Come to the nurse's office at lunch. I've prepared something special 💋'*

day3_classroom_nurse_band.name: School Nurse
day3_classroom_nurse_band.text: *She hands me the survey and places a band-aid on the back of my hand* "...You don't have a wound? Well... it's teacher's mark."

day3_classroom_nurse_pass.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_pass.text: *The nurse smiles gently as she hands me the survey and moves on.*

day3_classroom_nurse_leave.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_leave.text: *The nurse leaves the classroom. None of the other students noticed a thing.*

day3_break_time.name: Me
day3_break_time.text: *Break time. I check my phone — there are messages about weekend plans.*

day3_weekend_invite_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_weekend_invite_seoyeon.text: *Message* 'Hey {name}! Want to check out that new café this Saturday? I really want to go with you! ☕'

day3_weekend_yes_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_weekend_yes_seoyeon.text: *Instant reply* 'Really?! See you Saturday then! You can look forward to it! ♡'

day3_weekend_no_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_weekend_no_seoyeon.text: *Reply after a long pause* '...That's okay! Maybe next time!'

day3_weekend_invite_yuna.name: Yuna
day3_weekend_invite_yuna.text: *Message* '...Saturday night. 8 PM. The warehouse behind school. Come if you want the truth. Alone.'

day3_weekend_invite_dain.name: Dain
day3_weekend_invite_dain.text: *Message* '{name}!!! Wanna work out with me at the gym on Saturday?! See you at 9!! 💪🔥'
choices: Working out isn't really my thing...

day3_weekend_yes_dain.name: Dain
day3_weekend_yes_dain.text: *Reply in 0.5 seconds* 'AWESOME!! Don't forget your gym clothes!! 🏃‍♂️'

day3_weekend_no_dain.name: Dain
day3_weekend_no_dain.text: *Reply* 'Aww, too bad! But let's definitely do it next time!'

day3_weekend_invite_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_weekend_invite_nurse.text: *Message* 'Are you free this Sunday evening? I know a great restaurant I'd love to take you to... 😉'
choices: Sorry, I have plans on Sunday...

day3_weekend_yes_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_weekend_yes_nurse.text: *Reply* 'Great. I'll be waiting. Sunday at 7 PM 💋'

day3_weekend_no_nurse.name: School Nurse
day3_weekend_no_nurse.text: *Reply* 'That's a shame... Maybe next time then.'

day3_weekend_invite_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_weekend_invite_teacher.text: *Message* '{name}, there's a special exhibition at the city museum this Sunday. Want to go together? I'll give you extra credit too lol'

day3_weekend_yes_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
day3_weekend_yes_teacher.text: *Reply* 'Great! Let's meet Sunday at 2 PM. It'll be fun!'

day3_set_multiple_dates.name: Me
day3_set_multiple_dates.text: *...Wait. Did I just make plans with multiple people this weekend? I'm starting to feel uneasy.*

day3_morning_end.name: Me
day3_morning_end.text: *Classes began... and before I knew it, it was lunchtime.*
